stages.name: Customer Acquisition
stages.description: Marketing, lead generation, onboarding, and account opening

stages.name: Product Design & Pricing
stages.description: Developing deposit, loan, and fee-based products and setting rates

stages.name: Credit Assessment & Underwriting
stages.description: Risk scoring, due diligence, and approval for credit products

stages.name: Transaction Processing & Servicing
stages.description: Payments, account maintenance, branch/online service delivery

stages.name: Risk Management & Compliance
stages.description: Regulatory reporting, AML/KYC, fraud detection, and capital adequacy monitoring

stages.name: Revenue Management & Pricing Optimization
stages.description: Interest spread management, fee structuring, cross‑selling, and profitability analysis

stages.name: Customer Retention & Relationship Management
stages.description: Loyalty programs, advisory services, digital engagement, and churn mitigation

processes.name: Credit Application Intake
processes.purpose: Collect applicant data and documents for initial eligibility screening

processes.name: Automated Risk Scoring
processes.purpose: Apply predictive models to assess credit risk and generate a score for underwriting decisions

processes.name: Digital Campaign Management
processes.purpose: Design, launch, and track multi-channel marketing campaigns to generate qualified leads

processes.name: Online Account Opening
processes.purpose: Guide prospects through e‑KYC, document capture, and account creation in a seamless digital workflow

processes.name: LoyaltyProgramManagement
processes.purpose: Design, enroll, and track customer rewards to boost retention

processes.name: DigitalEngagementAnalytics
processes.purpose: Monitor and personalize digital interactions to reduce churn

processes.name: Product Conceptualization
processes.purpose: Define target customer segments, product features, and regulatory compliance for new deposit, loan, or fee-based offerings

processes.name: Rate and Fee Modeling
processes.purpose: Calculate optimal interest rates and fee structures using risk, cost, and competitive data to meet profitability and market positioning goals

processes.name: Interest Rate Portfolio Optimization
processes.purpose: Adjust loan and deposit rates to maximize net interest margin while managing risk and competitive positioning

processes.name: Fee Product Bundling and Cross‑Sell Management
processes.purpose: Design and price bundled fee-based services to increase fee income and deepen customer relationships

processes.name: Regulatory Reporting Consolidation
processes.purpose: Aggregate transaction and capital data to generate timely filings for Basel III and local regulator requirements

processes.name: AML/KYC Transaction Monitoring
processes.purpose: Analyze customer activity in real time to detect suspicious patterns and enforce anti‑money‑laundering compliance

processes.name: Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) Processing
processes.purpose: Execute and settle customer-initiated payments across accounts and external networks

processes.name: Account Maintenance Request Handling
processes.purpose: Process changes to customer account details and service preferences via branch or digital channels

activities.name: Gather applicant personal and financial information
activities.description: Collect basic data such as identity, income, employment, and credit history from the applicant via forms or interviews

activities.name: Request supporting documents
activities.description: Obtain required documents (pay slips, tax returns, ID, bank statements) through secure upload portals or email

activities.name: Validate data completeness and format
activities.description: Check that all required fields are filled and documents meet format standards, flag missing items

activities.name: Pre‑screen eligibility rules check
activities.description: Run rule‑based engine to assess eligibility thresholds (e.g., debt‑to‑income ratio, credit score) and generate initial decision flag

activities.name: Data collection and preprocessing
activities.description: Gather applicant financial data from internal systems and external sources, clean, normalize, and transform it for model input

activities.name: Model execution
activities.description: Run the predictive risk model on the prepared dataset to generate a credit risk score

activities.name: Score validation and exception handling
activities.description: Review model outputs for anomalies, apply business rules, and flag cases requiring manual review

activities.name: Decision communication
activities.description: Record the final score in the underwriting system and notify loan officers or customers of the decision

activities.name: Campaign brief creation
activities.description: Gather business objectives, target segments, messaging, and channel mix; document in a brief for approval

activities.name: Creative asset production
activities.description: Design and produce digital assets (email templates, banners, social posts) and copy per channel

activities.name: Campaign setup and launch
activities.description: Configure audience lists, schedule sends, set budgets, and activate tracking across email, social, display, and SMS platforms

activities.name: Performance monitoring and lead qualification
activities.description: Collect real‑time metrics, apply attribution models, and flag leads that meet scoring thresholds for sales handoff

activities.name: Collect prospect information and initiate e‑KYC
activities.description: User enters personal data, selects account type, and triggers electronic KYC verification

activities.name: Capture and validate identity documents
activities.description: Upload ID, proof of address; system performs OCR, facial match, and compliance checks

activities.name: Review compliance alerts and approve account
activities.description: Compliance officer reviews any exceptions flagged by automated checks and gives final approval

activities.name: Provision account and deliver credentials
activities.description: System creates account, assigns product features, and sends digital welcome kit to the customer

activities.name: Program Design
activities.description: Define reward tiers, eligibility criteria, and point accrual rules

activities.name: Customer Enrollment
activities.description: Capture customer data, verify identity, and enroll them into the loyalty program

activities.name: Transaction Tracking
activities.description: Record eligible transactions, calculate points earned, and update balances in real time

activities.name: Rewards Redemption Management
activities.description: Process redemption requests, apply discounts or benefits, and reconcile inventory

activities.name: Collect interaction data
activities.description: Gather clickstream, session, and transaction data from web and mobile channels

activities.name: Segment customers
activities.description: Apply clustering algorithms to group users by behavior and risk profile

activities.name: Generate personalized content
activities.description: Use recommendation engines to create tailored offers and UI elements in real time

activities.name: Monitor churn signals
activities.description: Track engagement metrics and trigger alerts for at‑risk customers for manual outreach

activities.name: Segment Identification
activities.description: Analyze demographic, behavioral, and profitability data to define target customer segments for the new product

activities.name: Feature Specification
activities.description: Map regulatory requirements and competitive benchmarks to draft product features, pricing, and eligibility rules

activities.name: Compliance Validation
activities.description: Run rule‑engine checks and generate compliance reports to ensure the product meets all legal and risk standards

activities.name: Business Case Development
activities.description: Aggregate financial forecasts, risk metrics, and go‑to‑market plans into a structured business case for approval

activities.name: Data aggregation
activities.description: Collect risk scores, cost inputs, and competitor rate/fee data from internal systems and market feeds

activities.name: Model calibration
activities.description: Run statistical/ML models to estimate profitability impact of rate/fee scenarios

activities.name: Scenario analysis
activities.description: Generate and compare multiple rate/fee configurations against profitability and positioning targets

activities.name: Decision approval
activities.description: Present recommended structures to governance committee for final sign‑off

activities.name: Data collection and cleansing
activities.description: Gather loan, deposit, market, and competitor rate data; clean and normalize for analysis

activities.name: Risk and profitability modeling
activities.description: Run statistical models to estimate net interest margin impact and credit risk under rate scenarios

activities.name: Scenario analysis and recommendation
activities.description: Generate rate scenarios, compare against risk limits and competitive benchmarks, and select optimal adjustments

activities.name: Rate implementation and monitoring
activities.description: Update system rate tables, communicate changes to branches, and track post‑implementation performance

activities.name: Define bundle components and eligibility criteria
activities.description: Gather product data, regulatory constraints, and customer segmentation to specify which fees and services can be combined and which customers qualify

activities.name: Model pricing and profitability
activities.description: Use analytics to calculate bundled pricing, forecast incremental fee revenue, and assess risk-adjusted profitability for each bundle

activities.name: Approve and publish bundle offering
activities.description: Route bundle proposals through compliance, risk, and product governance for sign‑off, then update digital channels and sales guides

activities.name: Monitor performance and trigger cross‑sell actions
activities.description: Track bundle uptake, fee leakage, and churn; generate alerts for sales reps to pursue upsell or remediation

activities.name: Data Extraction
activities.description: Pull transaction and capital data from core banking, risk, and accounting systems

activities.name: Data Validation & Reconciliation
activities.description: Apply rule‑based checks, match totals across sources, and resolve exceptions

activities.name: Report Assembly
activities.description: Map validated data to Basel III and local regulator templates, calculate ratios, and generate filing files

activities.name: Submission & Audit Trail
activities.description: Upload reports to regulator portals, log submission metadata, and archive supporting documentation

activities.name: Data Ingestion
activities.description: Collect transaction streams and customer profile data from core banking and external sources

activities.name: Rule‑Based Screening
activities.description: Apply regulatory rules and watch‑lists to flag transactions that exceed thresholds

activities.name: Alert Prioritization
activities.description: Score and rank alerts using machine‑learning risk models to focus analyst effort

activities.name: Case Management Review
activities.description: Investigate high‑risk alerts, document findings, and file SARs

activities.name: Validate payment request
activities.description: Check customer details, account status, and compliance rules before initiating transfer

activities.name: Authorize transaction
activities.description: Apply business rules, fraud detection, and obtain necessary approvals or signatures

activities.name: Execute settlement
activities.description: Send payment instructions to internal ledger and external network (ACH, SWIFT) and monitor acknowledgments

activities.name: Reconcile and notify
activities.description: Match settlement confirmations, update account balances, and generate customer notifications

activities.name: Request Intake
activities.description: Capture account change request from branch staff or digital form

activities.name: Eligibility Verification
activities.description: Validate customer identity and compliance rules

activities.name: Data Update Execution
activities.description: Apply changes to core banking system and update preferences

activities.name: Confirmation & Notification
activities.description: Generate confirmation, update audit log, and notify customer

roles.name: Personal Banker

roles.name: Loan Officer - Consumer Lending

roles.name: Branch Operations Manager

roles.name: Relationship Manager – Retail

roles.name: Risk Analyst – Retail Credit
roles.description: Assesses credit risk for consumer loan products and monitors portfolio health

roles.name: Product Manager – Deposit Services
roles.description: Defines features, pricing, and rollout plans for checking, savings, and term deposit products

roles.name: Digital Banking Specialist
roles.description: Leads implementation and support of mobile/app banking channels and digital onboarding

roles.name: Branch Manager
roles.description: Responsible for overall branch profitability, sales targets, regulatory compliance, and staff development

roles.name: Head of Retail Operations
roles.description: Sets operational strategy across the branch network, optimizes processes, and drives efficiency initiatives

roles.name: Chief Retail Banking Officer
roles.description: Executes the retail banking vision, oversees product, sales, risk, and technology integration at enterprise level

roles.name: Vice President – Retail Channel Strategy
roles.description: Defines multi‑channel distribution strategy, balances physical and digital touchpoints

roles.name: Chief Risk Officer – Retail Portfolio
roles.description: Governance of credit, fraud, and operational risk across all retail banking products

roles.name: Chief Technology Officer – Retail Banking
roles.description: Leads technology architecture, digital transformation, and cybersecurity for the retail banking division

skills.name: Process Documentation and Audit Trail Management

ai_opportunities.summary: Use NLP to auto‑extract personal and financial data from applicant forms or interview transcripts
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Document parsing and data extraction (NLP)
ai_opportunities.benefit: Reduces manual entry time by ~60% and lowers transcription errors
ai_opportunities.risk: Potential privacy breaches and mis‑extraction of critical fields
ai_opportunities.rationale: Local research (score 0.49) shows NLP can reliably pull identity, income, employment, and credit data from structured/unstructured inputs, but regulatory compliance still requires human oversight.

ai_opportunities.summary: AI can auto‑extract and preliminarily verify uploaded documents (pay slips, tax returns, ID, statements) using OCR and rule‑based checks.
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Document OCR, data extraction, and automated compliance validation
ai_opportunities.benefit: Reduces processing time by 30‑50% and lowers manual entry errors
ai_opportunities.risk: Potential privacy breaches and false‑negative validation of legitimate documents
ai_opportunities.rationale: Local research (score 0.54) shows AI can reliably extract data from uploaded PDFs, but human oversight remains needed for compliance and edge cases.

ai_opportunities.summary: AI can automatically validate retail banking data completeness and format using learned validation rules
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Machine learning‑based data validation
ai_opportunities.benefit: Speeds processing and reduces manual errors
ai_opportunities.risk: False positives/negatives may cause unnecessary rework or missed issues
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence describes validation rules and constraints that can be encoded in ML models to check required fields and formats, enabling automated checks.

ai_opportunities.summary: Apply AI-driven automated risk assessment to pre‑screen eligibility using rule‑based and scoring models
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Automated risk scoring / rule‑based decision engine
ai_opportunities.benefit: Real‑time, consistent eligibility decisions with higher throughput and compliance
ai_opportunities.risk: Potential bias in thresholds and regulatory scrutiny over automated credit decisions
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows automated risk assessment tools use AI and rule‑based systems to evaluate and score risks in real time, replacing slow manual reviews (evidence 0.54, 0.46)

ai_opportunities.summary: AI can automate data ingestion, cleaning, and normalization for loan applications in retail banking
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Data extraction, cleansing, and transformation using ML/NLP pipelines
ai_opportunities.benefit: Reduces processing time by up to 70% and improves data quality consistency
ai_opportunities.risk: Incorrect parsing of legacy formats or biased cleaning rules may lead to faulty credit decisions
ai_opportunities.rationale: Local research corpus indicates AI excels at structured financial data preprocessing, enabling high‑speed, repeatable pipelines

ai_opportunities.summary: Run predictive credit risk model on dataset to generate scores
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Predictive modeling and automated risk scoring
ai_opportunities.benefit: Real‑time, consistent credit risk scores with higher throughput
ai_opportunities.risk: Model bias or regulatory non‑compliance if inputs or logic are flawed
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows automated risk assessment tools use AI to evaluate and score risks in real time, replacing manual reviews (evidence 0.62, 0.61, 0.59).

ai_opportunities.summary: AI-driven anomaly detection and rule-based scoring can automatically validate model outputs and flag exceptions for review
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Anomaly detection with rule-based decision logic
ai_opportunities.benefit: Real‑time, consistent scoring reduces manual effort and speeds exception identification
ai_opportunities.risk: Potential false positives/negatives leading to missed risks or unnecessary escalations
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows automated risk assessment uses AI and configurable scoring matrices to evaluate outputs in real time, but human oversight remains needed for flagged anomalies (evidence 0.53, 0.50).

ai_opportunities.summary: Use AI-driven risk scoring to automatically record final underwriting scores and trigger decision notifications to loan officers or customers
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: AI risk scoring and rule-based workflow automation
ai_opportunities.benefit: Near‑real‑time, consistent decision logging and instant notifications, reducing manual effort and turnaround time
ai_opportunities.risk: Potential mis‑scoring or rule mis‑configuration could lead to incorrect decisions and regulatory compliance issues
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows configurable AI risk scoring and automated rule‑based processes can record scores and notify stakeholders in real time (evidence 0.45, 0.46)

ai_opportunities.summary: AI can draft campaign briefs by extracting objectives, segments, messaging, and channels from existing data and templates
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Natural language generation and information extraction
ai_opportunities.benefit: Speeds brief creation, ensures consistency, and frees analysts for strategic refinement
ai_opportunities.risk: Potential omission of nuanced business context or regulatory constraints
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows AI can retrieve and synthesize corpus data to populate brief components, but human oversight remains needed for compliance

ai_opportunities.summary: Generative AI can draft copy and create digital design assets for emails, banners, and social posts, accelerating production while requiring human review for brand alignment
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Natural language generation and generative image/model creation
ai_opportunities.benefit: Reduces turnaround time and enables rapid personalization across channels
ai_opportunities.risk: Potential brand voice drift, regulatory compliance issues, and bias in generated content
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows AI can move concepts to engineered outputs (0.51) and that copywriting aims to persuade (0.40), indicating generative models fit the task but human oversight remains essential

ai_opportunities.summary: AI can auto-generate audience segments, budget allocations, and schedule sends using predictive models, while monitoring cross‑channel performance in real time
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Predictive audience modeling, budget optimization, multi‑channel scheduling, and automated tracking integration
ai_opportunities.benefit: Faster campaign launch, higher ROI through data‑driven audience selection and budget efficiency
ai_opportunities.risk: Model bias or data quality issues could mis‑target audiences, leading to wasted spend and compliance concerns
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows campaign management involves full lifecycle planning, execution, and KPI tracking (0.54, 0.50, 0.48); AI can handle these steps end‑to‑end, enabling automation.

ai_opportunities.summary: Apply AI-driven real‑time scoring models to monitor performance metrics and qualify leads for sales handoff
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Predictive risk/lead scoring using attribution models
ai_opportunities.benefit: Instant identification of high‑potential leads, reducing latency and increasing conversion rates
ai_opportunities.risk: Model bias or mis‑scoring could mis‑prioritize leads, leading to lost opportunities or compliance issues
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows AI can automate real‑time risk scoring (0.58, 0.52, 0.44), which directly maps to lead qualification scoring thresholds.

ai_opportunities.summary: AI can automate data extraction and biometric verification in e‑KYC, speeding onboarding while ensuring compliance
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Computer vision for document and selfie verification, plus NLP for data validation
ai_opportunities.benefit: Reduces processing time and manual errors, improves fraud detection, and enhances customer experience
ai_opportunities.risk: Potential false‑rejects, bias in biometric models, and regulatory compliance concerns
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows eKYC relies on electronic data, biometric authentication and automated verification tools (e.g., document upload, live selfie) to create digital identity profiles, indicating AI‑driven verification can augment human review

ai_opportunities.summary: AI-driven eKYC for document capture, OCR, facial matching and compliance checks
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Computer Vision (OCR & facial recognition) + NLP for compliance rule checking
ai_opportunities.benefit: Speeds onboarding, cuts manual effort and fraud risk
ai_opportunities.risk: Potential false‑matches, bias, and regulatory compliance errors
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows eKYC uses OCR, selfie capture and AI fraud analysis to verify IDs and addresses, enabling fully automated digital onboarding (e.g., 0.52 evidence).

ai_opportunities.summary: AI can assist compliance officers by pre‑screening alerts and recommending approval decisions
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: AI‑driven risk assessment and decision support
ai_opportunities.benefit: Reduces review time and improves consistency of approvals
ai_opportunities.risk: Incorrect AI judgments could lead to regulatory breaches or missed fraud
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows AI tools can identify and prioritize risks in real‑time (0.52) and provide expert regulatory guidance (0.53), supporting but not replacing human final approval.

ai_opportunities.summary: AI can automate account creation, feature assignment, and digital welcome kit delivery in retail banking
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Intelligent workflow orchestration with NLP‑driven data extraction and rule‑based provisioning
ai_opportunities.benefit: Reduces manual effort and errors, speeds onboarding, and ensures consistent product feature assignment
ai_opportunities.risk: Incorrect provisioning or data leakage could lead to compliance violations and customer trust issues
ai_opportunities.rationale: User provisioning is a core IAM task that can be automated (evidence 0.59, 0.51); applying AI to orchestrate the workflow can replace manual steps

ai_opportunities.summary: Designing reward tiers and point rules is a strategic, policy‑driven task with limited pattern‑based data, so AI adds little value
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Rule‑based decision support (low‑complexity logic)
ai_opportunities.benefit: Minor consistency boost in eligibility checks
ai_opportunities.risk: Mis‑aligned tier structures if AI misinterprets business goals
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence focuses on automated risk scoring, not on reward program design, indicating AI relevance is low

ai_opportunities.summary: AI-driven identity verification and data capture can streamline retail banking customer enrollment into loyalty programs
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Document OCR and facial recognition for identity verification
ai_opportunities.benefit: Speeds enrollment, reduces manual errors, and enhances fraud detection
ai_opportunities.risk: Data privacy concerns and potential bias in biometric matching
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows loyalty program management focuses on capturing personal information and improving retention, implying AI can augment data capture and verification (evidence 0.47, 0.48)

ai_opportunities.summary: AI can automatically record eligible transactions, compute loyalty points, and update balances instantly using real-time classification models
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Real‑time transaction classification and points calculation via machine‑learning models
ai_opportunities.benefit: Immediate, error‑free point accrual improves customer experience and operational efficiency
ai_opportunities.risk: Incorrect classification or fraud could lead to wrong point awards and financial loss
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows AI can evaluate and act on data in real time (0.53, 0.43) and business rules can be encoded for automated decision flows (0.39)

ai_opportunities.summary: AI can automate rewards redemption by applying business rules and loyalty program logic to process requests, apply discounts, and reconcile inventory
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Rule‑based decision engine with AI‑enhanced risk assessment
ai_opportunities.benefit: Near‑real‑time processing, reduced manual errors, and consistent compliance
ai_opportunities.risk: Potential mis‑allocation of rewards or compliance breaches if rules are mis‑configured
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows AI‑driven loyalty platforms (Antavo AI Loyalty Cloud) manage reward campaigns (0.46) and business rules can drive automated approvals (0.40), enabling end‑to‑end redemption automation.

ai_opportunities.summary: Collect interaction data from web and mobile channels in retail banking
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Automated data ingestion and real‑time analytics using AI/ML models
ai_opportunities.benefit: Enables instant customer behavior insights for personalization and fraud detection
ai_opportunities.risk: Potential privacy breaches and bias in data interpretation
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows robust event tracking (clickstream, session, transaction) is foundational for engagement measurement and can be automated with AI for real‑time risk assessment (0.38, 0.41).

ai_opportunities.summary: Apply clustering to segment retail banking customers by behavior and risk profile
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: unsupervised learning (clustering)
ai_opportunities.benefit: more precise product targeting and risk management
ai_opportunities.risk: model bias or over‑fitting can create misleading segments
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows audience segmentation and automated risk scoring rely on algorithmic grouping to tailor messaging and assess risk (e.g., audience segmentation strategy and automated risk scoring references).

ai_opportunities.summary: Use AI recommendation engines to deliver real‑time personalized offers and UI elements in retail banking
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Recommendation Engine / Personalization
ai_opportunities.benefit: Higher conversion and customer engagement through tailored offers
ai_opportunities.risk: Potential bias in recommendations and privacy concerns over personal data usage
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows AI can automate real‑time decisioning (risk assessment) and personalize loyalty programs (Antavo AI Loyalty Cloud), indicating feasibility for recommendation‑driven personalization, though oversight is needed to manage bias and privacy.

ai_opportunities.summary: Use AI‑driven predictive analytics to monitor engagement metrics and flag at‑risk retail‑banking customers for manual outreach
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: predictive analytics and anomaly detection on transaction and interaction data
ai_opportunities.benefit: earlier churn identification enables timely interventions, boosting retention and revenue
ai_opportunities.risk: model bias or data privacy issues may generate false alerts or breach regulations
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows AI risk assessment tools can evaluate signals in real‑time (0.46) and that customer engagement analytics provide the data foundation for such insights (0.44,0.43)

ai_opportunities.summary: Use AI-driven clustering and predictive analytics on demographic, behavioral, and profitability data to generate refined customer segments for the new product
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: unsupervised learning (clustering) and supervised predictive modeling
ai_opportunities.benefit: Speeds segment creation and uncovers non‑obvious patterns, improving targeting and product‑market fit
ai_opportunities.risk: Model bias or privacy breaches could misclassify customers or expose sensitive data
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence defines audience segmentation as dividing a base into homogeneous subgroups for tailored messaging, which aligns with AI clustering techniques

ai_opportunities.summary: AI can parse regulatory texts and competitive data to suggest product features, pricing, and eligibility rules
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: NLP-driven regulatory and benchmark extraction with knowledge‑graph mapping
ai_opportunities.benefit: Speeds specification drafting and ensures alignment with compliance and market standards
ai_opportunities.risk: Potential mis‑interpretation of regulations leading to non‑compliant product designs
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence 0.58 shows AI can manage evolving regulations; evidence 0.45 highlights AI risk assessment improving compliance efficiency, supporting an assistive role.

ai_opportunities.summary: AI can drive rule‑engine compliance validation in retail banking by automating regulatory checks and report generation
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: AI‑powered rule engine and risk scoring
ai_opportunities.benefit: Real‑time, consistent compliance checks and faster report production
ai_opportunities.risk: Potential over‑reliance on model outputs and regulatory mis‑interpretation if models are not continuously updated
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows AI‑driven compliance frameworks (0.67) and automated risk assessment tools (0.65) that enable real‑time checks, indicating strong automation potential

ai_opportunities.summary: AI can consolidate forecasts, risk metrics, and go‑to‑market plans into a unified business case
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Generative data synthesis and risk scoring using large language models and predictive analytics
ai_opportunities.benefit: Speeds case assembly, improves consistency, and surfaces hidden risk‑return trade‑offs
ai_opportunities.risk: Model bias or outdated data could mis‑price risks, leading to flawed approvals
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows AI risk assessment tools (0.59) and configurable scoring (0.45) can automate data aggregation, while business rules (0.50) indicate human oversight remains needed

ai_opportunities.summary: AI-driven risk scoring and data aggregation from internal and market sources
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Predictive risk scoring and real-time data analytics
ai_opportunities.benefit: Accelerates collection and scoring of risk, cost, and competitor data, enabling near‑real‑time decision making
ai_opportunities.risk: Model bias or poor data quality could produce inaccurate scores and misinform pricing
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows automated risk assessment tools use AI for real‑time scoring and replace manual reviews (0.60, 0.55, 0.54)

ai_opportunities.summary: AI-driven predictive modeling for dynamic profitability scenario analysis in retail banking
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Predictive modeling and scenario simulation using statistical/ML techniques
ai_opportunities.benefit: Enables rapid, data‑driven pricing adjustments and risk‑aware profitability forecasts
ai_opportunities.risk: Potential model bias, regulatory compliance concerns, and over‑reliance on automated outputs
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows AI‑adjusted pricing (0.57) and automated risk assessment tools (0.55) already inform scenario outcomes, indicating AI can enhance but not fully replace human oversight.

ai_opportunities.summary: AI-driven scenario analysis can auto‑generate and rank rate/fee configurations using predictive profitability models
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: predictive modeling and optimization
ai_opportunities.benefit: speeds up configuration generation and improves alignment with profitability/positioning targets
ai_opportunities.risk: model bias and regulatory compliance concerns around dynamic pricing
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence 0.51 shows AI‑adjusted pricing formulas and 0.55 highlights real‑time AI risk assessment improving decision‑making, indicating AI can support but not fully replace human oversight

ai_opportunities.summary: AI can augment governance committee decision approval by providing real‑time regulatory compliance checks and risk scores
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Automated risk assessment and regulatory compliance validation
ai_opportunities.benefit: Faster, more consistent approvals with reduced compliance errors
ai_opportunities.risk: Over‑reliance on model outputs may miss nuanced judgment or introduce bias
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows AI‑driven risk assessment tools (0.42) and master regulatory compliance guidance (0.46) can support approval decisions, while business rules (0.42) indicate the need for human oversight

ai_opportunities.summary: AI can automate data collection from multiple sources and cleanse/normalize loan, deposit, market, and competitor rate datasets for retail banking
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Automated data extraction, entity recognition, and data cleaning using LLMs and ML pipelines
ai_opportunities.benefit: Speeds up data prep, reduces manual errors, and enables near‑real‑time analytics
ai_opportunities.risk: Potential propagation of source errors, regulatory compliance concerns, and over‑reliance on imperfect cleaning algorithms
ai_opportunities.rationale: Evidence shows a local research corpus (0.55 relevance) indicating that AI can ingest and normalize heterogeneous financial data, supporting full automation of this routine task

ai_opportunities.summary: AI-driven statistical modeling for net interest margin and credit risk under rate scenarios
ai_opportunities.ai_capability: Predictive analytics and simulation modeling
